title: FsMount
description: Mount the owner's JuiceFS volume (the user's shared folder, juicefs-shared-storage design). Sent on the live link only to a daemon whose hello has fs_mount: after the welcome when the owner has a ready volume, and again when the volume or its credentials change (generation grows). Unreliable and never logged or stored: it carries the volume's credentials. The daemon mounts at its own data directory and answers with fs.status; a generation older than the one mounted is ignored.

volume.description: Volume name (at-<id>), also the mount directory name.

generation.description: Grows when the volume's credentials change; a remount is due when it differs from the mounted one.

meta_url.description: Metadata engine URL without the password (postgres://jfs_x@host:port/db?sslmode=...&search_path=jfs_x); the password goes in META_PASSWORD.

access_key.description: Object storage key limited to the volume's prefix.

client.description: The juicefs client to run: the daemon picks the asset of its platform (linux-amd64, linux-arm64, darwin-arm64…), downloads it and checks sha256, unless that exact version is already present. A tar.gz holding the juicefs binary.
